description: List/test/manage connected social and CMS integrations (WordPress, Webflow, Ghost, Shopify, Webhook), fetch WordPress categories, get OAuth connect URLs, or manage signed outbound webhooks (list_webhooks, create_webhook, delete_webhook, test_webhook).

description.description: Optional description for an outbound webhook

url.description: CMS site URL, CMS webhook URL, or outbound webhook HTTPS target URL

webhookEvents.description: Outbound webhook event subscriptions (or "*" for all events)

webhookId.description: Outbound webhook ID for delete_webhook or test_webhook

name: wordflux_manage_integrations
